title: You Need Hydration
description: Added a drinking water mechanic to the game, along with dirty water, a thirst buff, and visual customizable settings.
body:
-You Need Hydration is a drinking mod centered around visual custom configuration, elevating compatibility with other mods and allowing you to create your own exclusive setup.

-All configurations support datapack import and export, and are fully compatible with global datapack mods,Paxi,and OpenLoader.

-It introduces dirty and clean water mechanics—dirty water bowls and bottles can be purified using a heat source.

Although the mod currently features only a few simple items, it will be gradually expanded in the future with more drinking-related elements.

Mod code is written by AI.
